subject: NorthStar RFI: evidence staging and SOC2/ISO clarification
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northstarbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northstarbank.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Redwood control evidence & timelines

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our security team landed on a shortlist and we are starting the formal RFI process. Attached is our RFI worksheet (v2) and a short SIG questionnaire. High level asks: a) control mapping to SOC 2 and ISO 27001, b) sample artifacts for encryption/key management and telemetry, and c) an expected delivery cadence for evidence collection (we typically run a two-week sprint).

Can you confirm who on your side will own the control crosswalk and whether we can get an initial packet within 10 business days? Tim from CyberAssure (copied) will be our external assessor and may ask for audit samples later.

Appreciate a quick note on timelines — we have an internal kickoff next Thursday.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
VP, Procurement — NorthStar Bank

Attachments: northstar_rfi_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northstarbank.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northstarbank.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Redwood control evidence & timelines

Elena —

Thanks for the RFI and the worksheet. Confirming receipt. I’ll own the control mapping deliverable and will coordinate the artifact bundle with our assurance team. Tentative plan:

- Day 0–2: intake & map the requested SIG questions to our SOC 2 controls and ISO 27001 Annex A references.
- Day 3–7: collect sample artifacts (logs, KMS proof, architecture diagram, access lists).
- Day 8–10: assemble crosswalk and a zipped sample packet for your review.

We can meet the 10-business-day ask, assuming no unexpected custodian delays. I’ll upload the working crosswalk to a shared Drive and send a DocuSign link if you want a formal acknowledgement of scope.

Jasmine — can you pull the latest SOC 2 control excerpts and the telemetry sample set? Priyom — can you confirm who the evidence custodians are for KMS and telemetry exports?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: reference: SOC2-Control-Snippets.zip (internal reference)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Redwood control evidence & timelines

Karthik —

Started pulling the SOC 2 excerpts. I have a lean set ready: 1) key rotation proof (key rotation job run logs), 2) telemetry retention sample (ingest partition + retention purge logs), 3) access review minutes (redacted). For ISO mapping I’ll reference Annex A controls and include a one-page mapping document.

I’ll drop the first artifacts into the shared Drive folder and include a README that calls out redactions and timestamps.

Jasmine
Senior Assurance Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments included to Drive: soc2-sample-logs.tar.gz (attachment stub), iso27001-scope-matrix.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Redwood control evidence & timelines

Quick note — I validated custodians: KMS owner: cloud-ops@redwood.ai (lead: Marcus Lin), Telemetry export: observability@redwood.ai (lead: David Kim). Two things to flag:

1) KMS proof: we can produce key metadata and rotation job logs, but any HSM vendor receipts will need a redaction/POA from the vendor.
2) Telemetry: we keep 90 days by default; exports beyond that require a data-retention request. If NorthStar needs longer retention samples, let us know.

I’ve pinged the two leads and asked for 72-hour turnaround on sample extracts.

Priyom
Assurance Operations — Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -07:00, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks — please add the retention comment to the README so the bank understands the default window.

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northstarbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northstarbank.com>, Tim Baker <tim.baker@cyberassure.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Redwood control evidence & timelines

Karthik/Jasmine/Priyom —

Appreciate the quick replies and the outline. A couple of clarifying points from our side before you assemble: 

- Can you include an index that maps each SIG question to the exact SOC 2 criterion and ISO control (Annex A reference) with page numbers?
- For sample artifacts, we primarily need proof-of-process rather than raw logs; redacted logs + execution timestamps are fine.
- Our assessor (Tim) will want to confirm the chain-of-custody for any audit samples. Tim — do you have additional checklist items?

If you can confirm the above, we’ll lock a kickoff for Thursday and expect the initial packet by Friday EOD next week.

Thanks,
Elena
VP, Procurement — NorthStar Bank

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northstarbank.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northstarbank.com>, Tim Baker <tim.baker@cyberassure.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Redwood control evidence & timelines — delivery plan

Elena / Team —

Short update and delivery plan: we hit the internal milestone today and uploaded a draft evidence packet to the shared Drive. Contents:

- NSB-RFI-crosswalk.xlsx (SIG question -> SOC2 control -> ISO Annex A mapping)
- README.md (artifact descriptions, retention windows, redaction notes)
- artifacts/soc2-sample-logs.tar.gz (redacted ingress logs)
- artifacts/kms-rotation-metadata.csv (key rotation job outputs)
- architecture/redwood-inference-network-diagram.pdf

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_shared_drive/NSB_RFI

A couple of clarifications per your ask: the crosswalk includes explicit references to the SOC 2 CC criteria and ISO annex clauses; sample artifacts are redacted and include execution timestamps and a chain-of-custody table. Tim — if you want, we can schedule a 30-minute call early next week to step through the artifact chain and provide any custodian attestations.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the packet meets the minimum acceptance criteria for your kickoff. We can iterate on additional artifacts after your assessor review.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: NSB-RFI-crosswalk.xlsx (spreadsheet), README.md (text)
